We also need to specify alpha if needed; default is 0.05. So we can just call with table: [10,20,30,40].

Since we don't know the exact return format, we can just output whatever the function returns. But we should explain the interpretation: compute chi-square statistic: (ad-bc)^2 * N / ((a+b)(c+d)(a+c)(b+d)). For table [[10,20],[30,40]], a=10,b=20,c=30,d=40,N=100. ad=400, bc=600, difference=-200, squared=40000. So chi-square = 40000*100/5040000 = 4000000/5040000 ≈ 0.79365. df=1. p-value ~ 0.374. So not significant at 0.05. So we can output that.
